front.title: AI Agents 6G System and RAN Requirements and Implementation Approaches

abstract.t: This document presents system and Radio Access Network (RAN) requirements for 3GPP Artificial Intelligence/ Machine Learning (AI/ ML) and AI Agents for the 6th generation mobile network, or 6G. Requirements depend on the types and application areas of agents. We describe some of them defined with each type and state their requirements. RAN 6G requirements are discussed including AI related requirements. AI Agent implementation efforts, initiatives on how APIs can be discovered, how inter-domain and intra domain AI Agents can be discovered using DNS lookup and agent protocol design are explained.
